spans.s: + पुत्रक मुनि- + पुत्रक, m. a wagtail.

मुनि, i. e. मन् + इ (उ for अ, by the influence of the preceding labial),
 I. m.
 1. A holy sage, endowed with divine inspiration, Vikr. d. 3.
 2. An ascetic, Pañc. 34, 13.
 3. The saint Agastya, Vyāsa,

. The name of two plants.
 II. f. नी̆, A female saint.
 --Comp.
+ वर मुनि- + वर, m. the chief of the ascetics, Ṛt. 6, 30.
+ श्रेष्ठ मुनि- + श्रेष्ठ, m. an excellent sage,
